claims.statement: Claims without timestamps and source roots go stale fast and let copied summaries masquerade as independent evidence.
Every recorded claim carries valid time, recorded time, reference frame, scale, scope, certainty, and anti-laundering provenance.
Checking mathematical theorems across six independent Lean proof kernels eliminates single-compiler blind spots completely.

easy_read.easy_title: Dated Sources and Six Proof Checkers
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about dated sources and six proof checkers.
Claims without timestamps and source roots go stale fast and let copied summaries masquerade as independent evidence.
Every recorded claim carries valid time, recorded time, reference frame, scale, scope, certainty, and anti-laundering provenance.
Checking mathematical theorems across six independent Lean proof kernels eliminates single-compiler blind spots completely.
Key result: 5,496 Six-Kernel Theorems · 0 Skipped Proofs.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
